svg.title: A failed try
svg.desc: Two lanes. Hermes Agent: a task card goes to one profile's station, which retries in place; three attempts are marked on the same station, and a card that re-blocks goes to a Triage tray. Yellowhammer: a Work Card goes to Route A, which fails and is tagged tried; the card then goes to Route B, which has not been tried; after the limit you set, a card that still cannot be finished lands in a Blocked or Waiting on You tray with a reason slip.
svg.text: New route, up to your limit
FIG 2 · SAME ROUTE AGAIN VS A ROUTE NOT YET TRIED
